narrative: Firming Treasury yields set up broad US dollar support into Sunday's opening session, with the 10-year yield climbing to 4.936% on Friday while the SOFR-€STR rate differential maintains a +150bp carry advantage favoring the buck. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.0937 and faces downside pressure at the open, reinforced by hawkish ECB minutes keeping December rate hike expectations intact. USD/JPY closed Friday at 159.56, where elevated US yields are likely to extend upside momentum toward the Sydney/Tokyo open despite structural intervention risk, positioning traders for key central bank decisions from the Fed and RBA in early December.
